subject.title: fix(security): narrow sandbox parent to exact active session workspace to prevent cross-agent media read (#107972)

question: Should agent-scoped media roots always remove the shared sandboxes parent and require each legitimate sandbox-reading caller to provide the exact active-session workspace?
rationale: The opt-in parameter creates an asymmetric security boundary; choosing the canonical fail-closed contract and its authoritative sandbox-context owner requires a media-security owner before merge.

options.title: Fail closed globally
options.body: Remove the broad sandboxes parent from all agent-scoped roots and thread exact active-session workspace context through every caller that must read sandbox media.

options.title: Pause for context redesign
options.body: Keep the PR open while defining a single authoritative session-to-sandbox context contract before changing authorization behavior.

recommendation.title: Fail closed globally
recommendation.body: Remove the broad sandboxes parent from all agent-scoped roots and thread exact active-session workspace context through every caller that must read sandbox media.

likelyOwner.reason: They designed and merged the existing agent-scoped media-root boundary and documented its cross-agent security intent.
